ili.Anaphase
The centromere of each chromosome splits. The
spindle fibres pull the chromatids apart to opposite
poles. Once the chromatids are separated, they are
calleddaughterchromosomes.

chromosomes move to one pole and half to the other

iv.Telophase
In telophase, spindle fibres break down. A nuclear
envelope forms around the chromosomes at each
pole of the cell. Thus two daughter nuelei are
formed, each with the same number of
chromosomes as were present in the parent
nucleus.
